description: A VSCode extension for quickly merging Git branches to specified branches
config.title: Git Quick Merge
config.branches.description: List of target branches for merging. Supports string format (target branch, uses current branch as source) or object format { to: 'target', from: 'source' }
config.branches.items.description: Branch name or branch config object
config.branches.items.from.description: Source branch to merge from (optional, defaults to current branch)
config.skipStaleWorktreeCheck.descriptio: Skip checking for stale worktree directories on startup
config.remoteRepoName.description: Remote repository name, default is origin
config.mergePresets.description: Predefined merge presets for one-click multiple branch merging
config.mergePresets.items.name.descripti: Display name for this merge preset
config.mergePresets.items.branches.descr: List of merge operations. Each item can be a target branch name (string) to merge from current branch, or an object with 'from' and 'to' properties for custom source/target branches
config.continueOnError.description: When multi-branch merge encounters an error, continue with remaining branches instead of stopping immediately
command.quickMergeTo.title: Quick Merge
command.cleanupStaleWorktrees.title: Cleanup stale worktrees
